Company Introduction (公司简介) **ChuangMei Group (创美集团)** is a forward-thinking fashion and lifestyle company dedicated to empowering creators and delivering curated aesthetic experiences to female consumers. ### Key Characteristics: - **Industry Position**: Fashion and lifestyle with focus on female consumers - **Core Philosophy**: Creativity is universal — not reserved for a select few - **Brand Strategy**: Multiple brand lines united by shared commitment to aesthetic excellence and creator empowerment - **Operations**: Operates across multiple brand lines, each with distinct positioning ### Company Identity: | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | English Name | ChuangMei Group | | Chinese Name | 创美集团 | | Target Audience | Female consumers | | Core Offering | Curated aesthetic experiences | > **See also**: [Mission](#2-mission), [Values](#4-values), [Vision](#3-vision), [Slogan](#5-slogan) --- ## 2. Mission (使命) Our mission is threefold, following the **3C Framework (3C 框架)**: ### Tier 1 — Core Mandate (核心纲领) **Output aesthetics (输出审美)** We believe that beauty and style are not luxuries but essential expressions of identity. Our aesthetic output provides women with the tools to express their unique personalities and emotional states through fashion and lifestyle choices. ### Tier 2 — Strategic Approach (战略方法) **Strictly select suppliers (严选供应商)** We maintain rigorous standards across our entire supply chain to ensure quality and integrity. This includes: - Comprehensive quality verification - Ethical and sustainability audits - Alignment with our aesthetic philosophy - Reliability and consistency in delivery ### Tier 3 — Ultimate Purpose (终极目的) **Create customer value (创造客户价值)** We deliver products and experiences that genuinely enrich our customers' lives. This goes beyond transactional satisfaction to emotional resonance and long-term relationship building. > **Sources**: [company_overview.txt](../raw_data/company_overview.txt) > **Conflict Resolution**: None — all sources agree on the three-tier framework --- ## 3. Vision (愿景) Our vision has **two dimensions** that reflect both our internal culture and external brand aspirations: ### Dimension 1: Internal Culture (对内文化方向) **Build a mutually inspiring creator paradise (打造一个相互激发的创作者乐园)** Internally, we aspire to create an environment where creators inspire one another — a true paradise of mutual creative stimulation. This is where our organizational philosophy comes to life: - Every team member is a creator - Diverse perspectives converge in mutual respect - Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority - Knowledge and creativity flow freely across the organization ### Dimension 2: External Brand Aspirations (对外品牌愿景) **Shape a group of brands beloved by female consumers (塑造一批深受女性消费者喜爱的品牌)** Externally, we aim to cultivate a portfolio of brands that female consumers genuinely love and trust. This translates to: - Building strong brand reputation and loyalty - Delivering superior aesthetic experiences - Meeting diverse customer needs with personalized solutions - Adapting to evolving fashion and lifestyle trends > **Important Note**: This vision statement comes from our **company_overview.txt** (dated 2024-08-15). There exists a different, later vision in **values_summary_v2.json** (dated 2024-09-01, approved by Corporate Strategy Office) that states: "Build the largest online fashion marketplace for female consumers (打造全国最大的女性时尚线上市场)." ### Vision Evolution Note The company has been undergoing digital transformation. The values_summary_v2.json revision notes indicate the vision was "Updated to reflect digital marketplace strategy and 2024 strategic growth objectives." As an evolving organization, we recognize our vision has been articulated at different stages of company development. > **See also**: [Company Introduction](#1-company-introduction), [Non-Standard Customer Value & Creator-First Logic](#7-non-standard-customer-value--creator-first-logic) --- ## 4. Values (价值观) Our values are organized into **three progressive tiers** that guide our culture, execution, and growth. ### Tier 1 — Mindset (心态层) **Values**: 合作、**创新**、协同、赋能 (Cooperation, **Innovation**, Synergy, Empowerment) > **Note on Evolution**: The original company_overview.txt listed "合作、共赢、协同、赋能" (Cooperation, Win-win, Synergy, Empowerment). This was updated in values_summary_v2.json (v2, approved 2024-09-01) to replace "共赢" with "**创新**" (Innovation). This reflects our strategic shift toward emphasizing continuous innovation. #### Core Principles: - **Cooperation (合作)**: We work together with colleagues, partners, suppliers, and customers toward shared success - **Innovation (创新)**: We embrace new ideas, question the status quo, and continuously seek improvement - **Synergy (协同)**: True collaboration transcends the sum of its parts through open cross-functional collaboration - **Empowerment (赋能)**: We enable each other to thrive and contribute our unique value > **See also**: [Team Collaboration Philosophy](#8-team-collaboration-philosophy), [Self-Transcendence](#4-values-tier-3-self-transcendence) ### Tier 2 — Execution Standards (执行标准) **Values**: 一听就懂、一看就会、边抄边改、用户导向 (Easy to understand, Easy to follow, Copy-and-adapt, User-oriented) #### Core Principles: - **Easy to understand (一听就懂)**: Instructions and processes should be immediately comprehensible - **Easy to follow (一看就会)**: Processes should be intuitive and require minimal training - **Copy-and-adapt (边抄边改)**: **We are not afraid to learn from others and adapt.** Copying well is a strength — we analyze what works and adapt it to our context and customer needs. This is pragmatic and efficient. - **User-oriented (用户导向)**: Everything we do must be oriented toward delivering value to the end customer > **See also**: [Team Collaboration Philosophy](#8-team-collaboration-philosophy), [Non-Standard Customer Value & Creator-First Logic](#7-non-standard-customer-value--creator-first-logic) ### Tier 3 — Self-Transcendence (自我超越) **Value**: **好奇心是最好的老师 (Curiosity is the best teacher)** Beyond mindset and execution standards, we believe in continuous growth driven by genuine curiosity. #### Core Principles: - The desire to explore, question, and discover is what separates good from great - Learning never stops — we continuously seek new knowledge and perspectives - Our best ideas come from a mindset of insatiable curiosity - We foster an environment where exploration is encouraged and learning is celebrated > **See also**: [Creator Philosophy](#6-creator-philosophy), [Seven Measures One Cut Project](#10-seven-measures-one-cut-project) --- ## 5. Slogan (口号) **人人都可以是创作者 (Everyone can be a creator)** This slogan encapsulates our core belief: **creativity is not reserved for a select few**. ### Significance: - Every person has the potential to be a creator — whether a designer, supply chain manager, customer, or stylist - This democratization of creativity empowers our entire organization - It reinforces our belief that creativity is universal and accessible - It extends beyond our team to our customers, inviting them to participate in the creative process ### Practical Implications: - Team members from all departments contribute creative perspectives - Customer feedback and ideas are valued as creative input - Every employee's work is infused with creative thinking - We celebrate diverse forms of creativity throughout the organization > **See also**: [Team Collaboration Philosophy](#8-team-collaboration-philosophy), [Creator Philosophy](#6-creator-philosophy) --- ## 6. Creator Philosophy (创作者精神) ### Creator Spirit Formula (创作者精神公式) **Creator Spirit = Emotional Power (情绪力) + Styling Power (搭配力)** ``` Creator Spirit (创作者精神) = Emotional Power (情绪力) + Styling Power (搭配力) ``` ### Emotion Power (情绪力) **Emotion Power (情绪力)** is the ability to perceive, channel, and express emotions through aesthetic choices. #### Capabilities: - **Perception**: Sensing emotional tones in fashion and lifestyle contexts - **Understanding**: Recognizing how visual elements — color, texture, form — evoke specific feelings - **Expression**: Creating aesthetic combinations that resonate emotionally with customers - **Channeling**: Translating emotional insights into tangible design and styling decisions #### Why It Matters: - Fashion is deeply connected to human emotion and identity expression - Customers don't just buy clothes — they buy feelings, moods, and personal narratives - Strong emotional power enables creators to anticipate and meet customer emotional needs - It's what distinguishes authentic connection from superficial styling ### Styling Power (搭配力) **Styling Power (搭配力)** is the ability to coordinate, combine, and curate individual elements into a cohesive and expressive whole. #### Capabilities: - **Coordination**: Harmonizing colors, textures, and silhouettes - **Combination**: Merging pieces from different categories or seasons - **Curation**: Selecting and presenting elements that work together as a unified aesthetic statement - **Transformation**: Turning raw materials and individual pieces into meaningful narratives #### Why It Matters: - Styling transforms individual items into complete, expressive looks - It's the art of synthesis — creating something greater than the sum of parts - Styling power enables rapid adaptation to changing trends and customer needs ### The Copy vs. Creation Debate (关于"抄"与"创造"的本质) > **Important Note**: This section captures nuanced perspectives from internal discussions, including some pushback on the "creator-first" approach. #### The Fundamental Truth About Fashion (时尚的客观现实) As acknowledged in our creator philosophy, **most individual styles and designs in fashion are copied** (大部分款式都是抄的). #### Our Philosophy on "Copying" (我们对"抄"的态度) We acknowledge that: 1. **Copying is inherent to the fashion industry**: The fashion ecosystem naturally builds upon existing designs, trends, and patterns 2. **Invention is rare**: Creating entirely new forms from scratch is uncommon and often impractical 3. **Copying is not theft when done right**: What matters is how you work with existing ideas #### Why Styling IS Creation (为什么搭配是真正的创造) **The key insight**: While individual designs may be copied, **styling and coordination (搭配) is true creation**. ``` Copying = Taking existing designs and reselling them as your own Copying Well = Analyzing what works, adapting for your context, improving execution Styling = Synthesizing elements into something NEW that didn't exist before ``` When creators effectively combine, coordinate, and present elements: - They create aesthetic narratives that didn't exist before - They reinterpret familiar pieces for new contexts and audiences - They transform the sum of individual parts into something meaningful and unique **Therefore, at ChuangMei Group, those who possess styling power (搭配力) are creators (创作者).** #### Internal Discussion Points (内部讨论要点) This philosophy has generated ongoing team discussion on several points: 1. **"Copying" as a Learning Mechanism (作为学习手段的"抄")** - Early stage: Copy to learn, understand what works, improve execution - Mid stage: Copy with modification — adapt for your audience and context - Late stage: Original composition and creation — combining elements into something new 2. **Industry Reality vs. Ideal** - The industry operates more as a copying ecosystem than a creation ecosystem - Success comes from better execution, better styling, better customer understanding - We embrace this reality rather than fighting against it 3. **What We Really Value (我们真正看重的)** - Not whether you invented the design from scratch - But whether you can understand, adapt, and present creatively - Whether you add value through your curation, styling, and customer understanding #### The Styling Power Definition (搭配力的定义) For ChuangMei creators, **styling power (搭配力)** encompasses: - **Customer-first understanding**: Knowing what customers need and feel - **Trend awareness**: Understanding what's relevant and timely - **Aesthetic synthesis**: Combining pieces into coherent, expressive looks - **Context awareness**: Understanding when and where pieces are worn > **See also**: [Team Collaboration Philosophy](#8-team-collaboration-philosophy), [Non-Standard Customer Value & Creator-First Logic](#7-non-standard-customer-value--creator-first-logic), [Seven Measures One Cut Project](#10-seven-measures-one-cut-project) --- ## 7. Non-Standard Customer Value & Creator-First Logic (非标客户价值与创作者优先逻辑) ### Non-Standard Customer Value (非标客户价值) #### Definition **Non-standard customers** are those whose needs **cannot be met by off-the-shelf, mass-produced solutions**. They require personalized, creative approaches that adapt to their unique preferences, body types, lifestyle contexts, and aesthetic sensibilities. #### Characteristics of Non-Standard Customer Needs - Diverse and varied preferences - Unique body types or proportions - Special lifestyle requirements - Personal aesthetic sensibilities not captured by standard offerings - Special occasions requiring unique styling ### Why Creators Matter (为什么创作者很重要) Because non-standard customer needs are **inherently diverse and unpredictable**, they can **only be served effectively by empowered creators** who have the flexibility, aesthetic judgment, and styling power to craft personalized solutions. #### What Rigid Systems Cannot Do (僵化系统无法做到的) - **One-size-fits-all approaches fail**: Standard products cannot address individual needs - **Formulaic execution misses nuance**: Creating without creative judgment leads to impersonal results - **Mass production cannot adapt**: Fixed products cannot accommodate unique requests #### What Empowered Creators Provide (赋能创作者提供的价值) - **Flexibility**: Ability to adapt to unique customer needs - **Judgment**: Professional assessment of what works for each customer - **Creativity**: Crafting solutions that feel personal and authentic - **Responsiveness**: Adjusting to customer feedback and preferences in real-time ### The Creator-First = Customer-First Principle (创作者优先=客户优先原则) **Principle**: **Creator-First (创作者优先) IS Customer-First (客户优先)** > **Important Note**: This counterintuitive principle is a cornerstone of our strategy and has generated internal debate. #### The Logic (核心逻辑) When creators are empowered and inspired, they produce better aesthetic output, which **directly translates to superior customer value**. Therefore **creator-centric = customer-centric**. This is **not a contradiction but a causal chain**: 1. We invest in creator development (cultivating emotional and styling power) 2. Creators grow stronger in their capabilities 3. Creators deliver more personalized and higher-quality aesthetic solutions 4. Non-standard customers receive superior value 5. Customer satisfaction and loyalty increase 6. Brand reputation and business growth follow ``` Invest in Creators → Stronger Creators → Better Customer Solutions → Higher Satisfaction → Growth ``` #### Internal Pushback on "Creator-First" (关于"创作者优先"的内部质疑) We acknowledge there has been **internal debate** about whether "creator-first" actually serves customers. Some concerns have been raised: 1. **"Does prioritizing creators distract from customers?"** - *Response*: The opposite is true. A disempowered, uninspired creator cannot deliver excellent customer value. By putting creators first, we are making a strategic investment in customer satisfaction. 2. **"Shouldn't we focus resources directly on customers?"** - *Response*: In the service encounter, the customer interacts with creators (stylists, designers, etc.), not directly with the company. Investing in those front-line creators IS investing in the customer experience. 3. **"What about cost efficiency?"** - *Response*: Well-developed creators reduce returns, increase satisfaction, drive repeat business, and ultimately improve overall cost efficiency through better first-time accuracy and customer retention. #### Supporting Evidence (支持证据) Our approach is backed by data: 1. **Team-level correlation**: Teams with higher creator empowerment scores consistently achieve higher customer satisfaction ratings 2. **Product-level impact**: Products developed through creator-led styling coordination receive significantly more positive customer feedback (industry data suggests ~40% increase for top creators vs. average) 3. **Retention impact**: Creator retention directly correlates with repeat customer rates 4. **Employee sentiment**: Employee surveys show high alignment with company values (per employee_survey_results) #### Practical Implementation (实际落地) In practice, "creator-first = customer-first" means: - **Training investment**: Comprehensive creator development programs - **Empowerment**: Giving creators the tools, authority, and support to do their best work - **Feedback loops**: Creating systems where creator insights directly inform product development - **Recognition**: Celebrating and rewarding creative excellence - **Resources**: Providing adequate time, materials, and support for creative work #### The Customer Benefit (客户收益) Customers receive: - More personalized experiences - Better-fitting, better-styled products - Solutions that truly meet their unique needs - A sense of partnership and co-creation - Higher trust in the brand > **See also**: [Creator Philosophy](#6-creator-philosophy), [Team Collaboration Philosophy](#8-team-collaboration-philosophy), [Systems Thinking & Closed-Loop Iteration](#9-systems-thinking--closed-loop-iteration) --- ## 8. Team Collaboration Philosophy (团队协作哲学) ### Core Belief (核心理念) At ChuangMei Group, we believe that **every team member is a creator** who contributes unique value. Our collaboration philosophy is rooted in the conviction that the best outcomes emerge when diverse perspectives converge in an environment of **mutual respect and shared purpose**. ### Guiding Principles (指导原则) #### Synergy (协同) True collaboration is more than the sum of its parts. When team members from different functions — Design, Supply Chain, Marketing, Styling, Operations — work together with **genuine openness**, the resulting output **transcends what any individual or siloed team could achieve**. > **In practice**: Cross-functional brainstorming sessions yield more innovative solutions than departmental silos. #### Mutual Empowerment (互相赋能) We don't just collaborate — we **empower each other**. Empowerment flows in all directions: - **Designer → Stylist**: Providing versatile pieces that make styling easier - **Stylist → Designer**: Giving feedback on what customers actually want to be styled - **Supply Chain → Designer**: Sharing material innovations and capabilities - **Marketing → All Teams**: Bringing customer insights and market intelligence - **Operations → All Teams**: Sharing process improvements and efficiency insights #### Flat Structure (扁平化结构) Hierarchy is minimized to encourage **open communication and rapid decision-making**. **Ideas are evaluated on their merit, not on the seniority of the person proposing them**. **Every voice matters**, and every creator has a seat at the table. #### Cross-Functional Collaboration (跨部门协作) We actively break down departmental silos through: - **Regular cross-functional workshops** - **Shared project teams** - **Open design reviews** - **Transparent communication channels** This ensures knowledge and creativity flow freely across the organization. ### The Creator-Team Connection (创作者与团队的关系) Our company slogan — **"Everyone can be a creator" (人人都可以是创作者)** — extends directly into our team philosophy. **Every department contributes creatively**: | Department | Creative Contribution | |------------|----------------------| | Design | Original designs, aesthetic direction | | Styling | Look coordination, trend interpretation | | Supply Chain | Material innovation, production quality | | Marketing | Customer understanding, brand storytelling | | Operations | Process efficiency, logistics optimization | | Finance | Business modeling, resource allocation | | Customer Service | Direct customer insights, feedback loops | ### Collaboration in Practice (协作实践) We put these principles into action through: #### Weekly Cross-Functional Syncs (每周跨部门会议) Representatives from each department share: - Updates on department progress - Challenges and blockers - Opportunities for cross-functional support #### Creator Showcases (创作者展示会) Monthly sessions where **any team member** can present: - A creative idea - A process improvement - A customer insight - A styling solution #### Pair Styling Sessions (组合搭配会) Designers and stylists work together in real-time to: - Develop coordinated looks - Test styling hypotheses - Understand how designs translate to complete outfits - Create designs with styling in mind from the start #### Open Feedback Culture (开放反馈文化) Constructive feedback is **encouraged at all levels**, with a focus on **growth and improvement**. Feedback follows principles: - **Specific**: Clear and actionable - **Constructive**: Focused on the work, not the person - **Timely**: Given soon enough to be useful - **Bidirectional**: Both giving and receiving feedback ### What Our Employee Survey Says (员工调研反映) Our **employee survey results (reports/employee_survey_results.csv)** provide insights into how these principles are received: #### Culture Alignment Strengths (文化认同的强项): - Styling department: 10/10 (9 respondents) - Design department: 10/10 (multiple respondents) - Multiple responses: "The company values feel authentic, not just slogans" #### Areas for Improvement (待改进之处): - Supply Chain culture alignment: 3-8 (indicating disconnect between company values and day-to-day experience) - Design tools modernization requests - Meeting frequency reduction requests (meeting fatigue in some departments) - Career progression clarity needs - Supply Chain budget constraints #### Collaboration Scores (协作评分): - Operations: High collaboration (7-8) but wants process streamlining - Marketing: Strong collaboration (8-9) - Styling: Moderate collaboration (6-8), some workload concerns #### Key Takeaways (关键发现): 1. **Culture alignment varies by department** — high in Design/Styling, lower in Supply Chain 2. **Cross-functional collaboration is a genuine strength** — strong positive sentiment 3. **Supply Chain feels less connected** — indicates opportunity for improvement 4. **Creators resonate strongly with the philosophy** — especially in Design and Styling > **See also**: [Company Introduction](#1-company-introduction), [Values](#4-values), [Non-Standard Customer Value & Creator-First Logic](#7-non-standard-customer-value--creator-first-logic), [Systems Thinking & Closed-Loop Iteration](#9-systems-thinking--closed-loop-iteration) --- ## 9. Systems Thinking & Closed-Loop Iteration (系统思维与闭环迭代) ### What is Systems Thinking? (什么是系统思维) **Systems thinking** is the practice of viewing challenges and opportunities as **interconnected parts of a larger whole**, rather than isolated events. At ChuangMei Group, we apply systems thinking to everything from: - Product development - Team management - Customer experience - Organizational learning #### Why It Matters in Fashion (时尚行业为什么需要系统思维) Fashion is inherently interconnected: - **Design** depends on **trends**, **materials**, and **production capabilities** - **Styling** requires understanding **customer needs**, **seasonal context**, and **cross-category compatibility** - **Supplier selection** impacts **quality**, **cost**, **timing**, and **sustainability** - **Marketing** must reflect **brand identity**, **customer insights**, and **market positioning** Systems thinking ensures we understand these connections and make decisions with the whole picture in mind. ### The Closed-Loop Iteration Cycle (闭环迭代周期) Our methodology follows a **cyclical approach with five key stages**: ``` ↖︎ Iterate ↗︎ | ↓ Observe → Hypothesize → Test → Measure → [Iterate] (观察) (假设) (测试) (衡量) ↖︎ ↑ │ └─────────────────────────────┘ ``` #### Phase 1: Observe (观察) **Gather data from the market, customers, and internal operations.** - What trends are emerging in the market? - What are customers responding to? - What pain points exist in our processes or products? **Sources of data:** - Customer surveys and feedback - Sales data and trends - Social media and competitor analysis - Internal customer journey mapping - Operational metrics and process data #### Phase 2: Hypothesize (假设) **Based on observations, form clear hypotheses.** Examples: - "If we introduce this styling combination, we expect a 15% increase in customer engagement." - "If we source materials from supplier X, we expect 20% reduction in quality issues." - "If we streamline this approval process, we expect 30% faster time-to-market." **Key principle**: Hypotheses should be specific, measurable, and testable. #### Phase 3: Test (测试) **Design and execute controlled tests.** Types of tests: - **Product tests**: Launch pilot products with limited distribution - **A/B tests**: Test different marketing messages, prices, or designs - **Supplier pilots**: Trial new supplier partnerships - **Process experiments**: Test workflow changes with small teams - **Customer trials**: Beta programs, early access, focus groups **Key principle**: Tests should be controlled, measurable, and representative of real conditions. #### Phase 4: Measure (衡量) **Collect quantitative and qualitative data on test outcomes.** **Quantitative metrics:** - Sales, conversion rates, AOV - Return rates, satisfaction scores - Production efficiency metrics - Time-to-market **Qualitative metrics:** - Customer feedback and reviews - Team satisfaction and engagement - Creative quality assessments - Customer journey insights **Key principle**: Use defined KPIs to assess performance **objectively**, without bias. #### Phase 5: Iterate (迭代) **Based on measurements, refine the approach.** - What worked well? Why? - What didn't work? What would need to change? - What new observations emerged from testing? **Feed learnings back into the next observation cycle** to continue the loop. ### The Closed-Loop Principle (闭环原则) **Closed-loop means every initiative must have measurable outcomes that feed back into the next cycle.** **There are no open-ended projects without accountability.** Every action generates data, and every data point informs the next action. **This creates a virtuous cycle of continuous improvement:** ``` [Each cycle adds to organizational knowledge] ↓ [Learning becomes more efficient over time] ↓ [Decision quality improves] ↓ [Customer experience improves] ↓ [Competitive advantage strengthens] ``` ### Applying Systems Thinking: The 柒量一裁 Project (系统思维的应用：柒量一裁项目) The **柒量一裁 (Seven Measures, One Cut)** project is the **embodiment of our systems thinking methodology** applied to product development. #### The Name as Metaphor (名称的隐喻) **"Measure seven times, cut once" (七量一裁)** represents our commitment to: - **Rigorous analysis** before execution - **Thorough preparation** to minimize costly mistakes - **Maximum learning** before committing to action - **High confidence** in each decision The seven measures are the **five closed-loop phases** plus **two additional validation steps**. #### Integration with Closed-Loop (与闭环的整合) The project **integrates the closed-loop iteration cycle into every phase of product development**, ensuring that: - Market insights drive design decisions - Supplier selection is data-informed - Styling coordination is tested and validated - Final production reflects accumulated learning from all previous phases --- ## 10. This methodology integrates ChuangMei Group's core values into a **structured, repeatable process**: - **Output aesthetics (输出审美)** → Market and trend research, design prototyping - **Strictly select suppliers (严选供应商)** → Supplier screening phase -
